title: Meet the Microbes
summary: Bacteria, fungi, protozoa, algae and viruses: where they live, how big they are, and why viruses are special.

ib.note: Microbial cell structure (prokaryotes) is studied in MYP 5 / DP

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 2: The Invisible Living World: Beyond Our Naked Eye
Earlier NCERT Ch 2: Microorganisms: Friend and Foe

objectives: I can name the five main groups of microorganisms with an example of each.
I can describe where microorganisms live.
I can explain how viruses differ from other microbes.
misconceptions: All microbes are germs that cause disease.
Microbes only live in dirty places.
